Neighbouring zones exchange heat through a small shared area, so heating zone i also warms zones i-1 and i+1. Open-loop time constant ~ 3 min; sensors lag the heater by ~ 12 s. At 100 % output an odd zone settles near 71 degC and an even zone near 62 degC (nominal, isolated). Steady-state temperature rises roughly linearly with delivered power.",
